purpose: Evidence-qualified aqueous-pH comparison contexts, not in-vivo molecular population predictions.
interpretation_rules: Select overlays explicitly; never imply that a study preset measures the current user or drawing.
Preserve all source boundaries without snapping them to the 0.1-pH calculation grid.
Reference intervals, observed ranges, confidence intervals, and point estimates have distinct display semantics.
Do not manufacture a band around a point or reinterpret an unspecified plus/minus statistic.
Species, preparation, conditions, measurement handling and evidence gaps remain visible.
Synaptic cleft is separate from vesicle lumen and extracellular bathing solution.
Nephron luminal fluid is separate from plasma, renal cytosol, interstitium and peritubular blood.
Do not infer monotonic nephron acidification or join different nephron classes into one measured trajectory.
In-situ and equilibrium tubular-fluid pH are distinct measurement conditions; equilibrium pH can also be measured in vivo, and carbon-dioxide handling matters (DuBose 1982).
Final-urine overlays are intentionally excluded by the accepted scope correction.
Custom comparison ranges must be labeled user-defined and must not replace an evidence-gap record.
These contexts do not establish brain exposure, synaptic concentration, renal transport, trapping, clearance, receptor activity or patient-specific physiology.
